name: USDA NASS Quick Stats
tagline: Authoritative US crop, livestock, and farm economics survey and census data.
description: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) Quick Stats API provides programmatic access to official U.S. agricultural statistics from surveys and the Census of Agriculture. Query crops, livestock, prices, inventory, acreage, production, and farm economics by commodity, geography, year, and statistic with a free API key.

auth.details: API key via query parameter `key`; free self-serve signup on the Quick Stats API page.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free with an API key; limited to 100 calls within five minutes and 50,000 records per response. No daily-call quota is published.

use_cases: get corn production by state and year
pull livestock inventory for a county
fetch Census of Agriculture farm counts by geography
export commodity statistics for a custom query
